summary: As an Indian company using a cultivated, non-codified-TK species for commercial utilisation and export, State Biodiversity Board approval is required before commercial use; NBA approval is required before filing an IPR application.

checklist.title: State Biodiversity Board (SBB) intimation
checklist.detail: Required for Indian entities using biological resources for commercial utilisation, even when cultivated.

checklist.title: National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) approval before IPR application
checklist.detail: Required before applying for any IPR based on research or information from a biological resource obtained from India.

nodes.label: Is the applicant an Indian company?

ev_bd0101.text: no person shall, without the previous approval of the National Biodiversity Authority, undertake specified activities involving obtaining biological resources for research, commercial utilisation, or bio-survey (illustrative paraphrase).
